description: Check for plugin updates now: runs every Plugin Update Checker instance (GitHub-released plugins such as the cvrt-* and wp-woo-pdf-builder; their own check otherwise runs every 12 h) and a fresh wp.org check. plugin limits the PUC run to one plugin. Returns puc_checked (slugs) and updates [{plugin, name, current, new_version, source: puc|wporg}]. Audit-logged. cvrt-mcp-endpoints 1.16.0+.

plugin.description: Plugin file path to limit the PUC check to (e.g., wp-woo-pdf-builder/wp-woo-pdf-builder.php)

name: mcp_check_plugin_updates
